def diff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); c = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(); rows={}
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,c)):
        for j,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)):
            if u!=v:
                cnt[(u,v)]+=1; rows.setdefault(i,Counter())[ (u,v) ]+=1
    return dict(cnt), rows

def diff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); c = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(); rows={}
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,c)):

                cnt[(u,v)]+=1; rows.setdefault(i,Counter())[ (u,v) ]+=1
    return dict(cnt), rows
